Status: Wave 312 accepted (6.3): the LoadDevice step cluster and its contracts

Method.evidence: Eleven type names, every one anchored on the readable 6.4 counterpart or on a literal inside the 6.3 binary. Two classes name themselves in their own logger-category strings: Class474 = Knx.Ets.Hawk.Impl.IoT.Tasks.LoadDevice.ApplicationProgramDownload.IoTApplicationProgramDownloader and Class497 = Knx.Ets.Hawk.Impl.IoT.DeviceImage.DeviceImageWriting.IoTDeviceImageWriter (Class498 already carried the same evidence as IoTDeviceImageCreator). The two remaining classes match the 6.4 classes field for field: Class475 (ApplicationProgramData + data facade, checks manufacturer id and hardware type, throws IncompatibleTargetDeviceException) = ...HardwareTypeCheck.IoTHardwareTypeChecker, Class476 (project data, stores the fingerprint derived from the programming state) = ...FingerprintManagement.IoTFingerprintManager. Their contracts are the interfaces they implement: Interface20/21, while Class497/Class498 implement Interface25/26. Interface10 is Interface10 of the already-named IoTProgrammingModeManager and matches 6.4 IIoTProgrammingModeManager member for member; Interface23 (three Indicate* members) and Interface24`2 (stage, set stage, stage list, goals, NextStage) are 6.4 IIoTTaskState and IIoTTaskState`2, which the 6.3 fields instantiate with the same IoTApplicationProgramDownloadStage/IoTApplicationProgramDownloadGoals arguments. The IIoTTaskState pair is why the pass needed the arity rule fixed (de4dotEx 35cff436).
Method.themes: One wave settles the whole LoadDevice/ApplicationProgramDownload step cluster and its DeviceImage collaborators: the downloader, the hardware-type checker, the fingerprint manager, the device-image writer and the four contracts plus the state pair. Class474's four interface accessors (method_0/2/3/4) return exactly these interfaces and are now nameable, which is the next wave's work; the untyped collaborators the cluster still shares (ne, nz, Class489/Class319, fb, id, l6) live outside HawkNET and need their own module's evidence first.
